summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Rareview Government Money Market ETF (RMME) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in ultra short-term, high-quality government debt aiming to generate income as an alternative to holding cash. RMME was launched on Dec 1, 2025 and is issued by Rareview Funds.
